nfl_venue.method: Research for make_player_prop_params.HOME_AWAY_MULTIPLIERS. For each market the gap is the ratio of actual to baseline expected output at home and away, each divided by the overall ratio, so an era-level bias in the baseline is not counted as a venue effect. Neutral sites are excluded.
